amino acid substrates. The amino group of the substrate displaces the lysine ε-amino group forming a new aldimine with the PLP
(“external aldimine/external Schiff base”). This increases the reactivity of the a, b and g carbons of the amino acid. The reactions that
are catalyzed at the a-carbon include transamination, decarboxylation, racemization and elimination and replacement of an elec-
trophilic group. Reactions catalyzed at the b and g carbons include eliminations and replacements (Eliot and Kirsch, 2004).
The notable exception to the general rule that PLP-catalyzed reactions occur through the formation of an external aldimine of
